subject.title: refactor(agents): split embedded session lock lifecycle

question: Does the maintainer approve this large behavior-preserving decomposition after reviewing real lock lifecycle proof on the final merge head?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label and the session-state/availability-sensitive ownership logic require an explicit human decision; automated test and static evidence does not establish the real prompt-release and takeover path.

options.title: Request live lifecycle proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted runtime transcript or logs proving release, in-process handoff, reacquisition, and external-takeover rejection before approving the refactor.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: Approve based on the existing focused tests and CI if the maintainer is satisfied that this internal refactor does not need an end-to-end runtime demonstration.

recommendation.title: Request live lifecycle proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted runtime transcript or logs proving release, in-process handoff, reacquisition, and external-takeover rejection before approving the refactor.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context identifies this contributor as the author of the session-lock decomposition and its accompanying validation evidence.
